activities.architecture: Pure 2D grid line maze on flat dark backdrop, primitive colored circles for player and stars, arrow/touch controls
activities.strengths: Diverse biome color themes (galaxy, forest, crystal, volcano), multi-tier maze generator
activities.weaknesses: Looks like an ungrounded algorithmic debug screen; walls are plain rectangular lines, player is a simple circle with no character actor or tactile presence, goal is an empty square
activities.shared_visuals: character.dani or character.tito, crystal collectibles, portal goals, biome wall textures
activities.opportunity: CREATE_ORIGINAL + COMPOSE_ADAPT (Layered maze tiles, mascot adventurer, luminous magical portal goal)

activities.architecture: Basic colored rectangle train on flat background, crude procedural wheel spokes, straight brown lines for tracks, overlapping circle fruits
activities.strengths: Great zero-text visual math equation design, steam whistle audio, interactive fruit loading
activities.weaknesses: Objectively the most visually crude and flat activity in the entire catalogue; locomotive looks like primitive debug geometry, landscape is empty 2-color ellipses, fruit baskets are plain rectangles
activities.shared_visuals: distant hills, clouds, sunbeams, trees, train engine/caboose art, fruit crate baskets
activities.opportunity: CREATE_ORIGINAL + COMPOSE_ADAPT (Rich scenic railway valley, illustrated steam locomotive & wagon, wooden fruit crates, Dani conductor)

activities.architecture: Flat cyan/midnight blue fill, crude procedural polygon fish/turtles/octopuses, simple wavy lines for kelp, circular food pellets
activities.strengths: Fun day/night bioluminescence switch, gentle bubble physics
activities.weaknesses: Zero depth layering, no underwater light caustics, rock arches, sunken castle or coral reefs; sea creatures are crude primitive geometric ellipses
activities.shared_visuals: aquatic fauna, underwater flora, seabed rock formations

activities.architecture: White document sheet, text cursor, floating toolbar, basic typography
activities.weaknesses: Bare sterile document canvas, lacks child-friendly desk/easel framing or playful writing accessories

activities.architecture: Grid of cards on plain pastel backdrop, card flip animation, animal/sweet/vehicle icon drawings
activities.strengths: Solid flip animation, clean high-contrast icons
activities.weaknesses: Entire card grid floats on empty flat color; lacks a tactile wooden game table, play mat, or atmospheric room environment

activities.architecture: Greenhouse interior, 3 plant pots, procedural sunflower/tulip/strawberry growth stages, tool palette (seeds, water, sun, harvest)
activities.strengths: Delightful growth cycle mechanics, thought bubble care hints
activities.weaknesses: Pots and plants are basic polygon drawings; greenhouse backdrop lacks glass panels, potting bench, watering cans, or sunbeams

activities.architecture: Striped wallpaper background, examination table bed, procedural animal patient, tool palette (stethoscope, bath, bandaid, food, cuddle)
activities.strengths: Clear medical tool order cues, sweet nurturing theme
activities.weaknesses: Sparse clinic environment without veterinary cabinets, medicine bottles, posters or room depth; procedural patient drawing is basic

activities.architecture: Enchanted forest background, Leo the owl mascot on branch, floating glowing letter orbs, phonics audio feedback
activities.strengths: Great Leo the owl character integration, glowing orb physics, responsive phonetic speech
activities.weaknesses: Forest trees in background are flat vector silhouettes; card presentation is basic

activities.architecture: Side-scrolling sky runner, procedural dragon with customizable accessories, rainbow boost arches, golden stars
activities.strengths: Fluid motion, energetic particle bursts, fun dragon accessories
activities.weaknesses: Background clouds and rainbow arches are repetitive procedural shapes without scenic landscape below

activities.architecture: Tactile syllable cards, word illustration badges, drag/tap syllable combining slots, phonetic audio feedback
activities.strengths: Clear educational affordances, high-contrast readable typography, playful syllable color coding
activities.weaknesses: Meadow background behind the cards is plain; word cards float without a grounded table/easel

activities.architecture: Tactile settings panel, profile cards, sliders, hardware status indicators, parent lock dial
activities.strengths: Clean system utility, clear visual feedback for settings, high accessibility
activities.weaknesses: Intentionally utilitarian rather than playful game world

activities.architecture: Concert bandstand stage, 6 animal musicians with instruments, musical note waves, rhythm tempo lights
activities.strengths: Vibrant musical stage, clear instrument affordances, delightful instrument audio feedback
activities.weaknesses: Musicians are seated on flat procedural circles rather than grounded chairs/risers

activities.architecture: Bakery shop counter, tiered cakes, cream icing layers, fruit decorations, customer order cards
activities.strengths: Tactile appetizing cake layers, clear customer order matching, cheerful dessert palette
activities.weaknesses: Bakery background wallpaper and customer animals are relatively simple

activities.architecture: Red velvet theater stage, wooden proscenium, puppet stick characters (princess, dragon, knight, fairy), stage lighting
activities.strengths: Classic tactile puppet theater framing, gold tassels, expressive character puppets
activities.weaknesses: Background scenery drops are somewhat flat gradient backdrops

activities.architecture: Isometric bedroom backdrop, pet bed, interactive ball physics, thought bubbles, multi-state pet animation
activities.strengths: Cozy inviting interior, dynamic puppy state machine (sleep, eat, play, bath), tactile toy physics
activities.weaknesses: Toy box and wall decorations are somewhat flat procedural rectangles

activities.architecture: Dense layered forest scenery, animated peeking animals (owl, fox, squirrel, bear), foliage shadows, star collection HUD
activities.strengths: Superb environmental depth, atmospheric woodland lighting, expressive animal peeking cues
activities.weaknesses: Slightly static foreground trees in lower resolutions

activities.architecture: PygameReferenceCanvas + PygameSceneRenderer + SceneActorDefinition (Flash the rabbit with dynamic facial states, suspension cables, world cliffs, particle bursts)
activities.strengths: Exceptional canonical mascot integration, expressive hopping and landing physics, world backdrops (river, canyon, space), celebration fanfare

activities.architecture: PygameReferenceCanvas + Shared UI Mixins + Color palettes + coloring pages + texture stamps + tactile undo/redo/save cards + zoom/pan canvas
activities.strengths: Rich vibrant coloring templates, tactile stamp textures, clean child-first layout, smooth brush lines

activities.architecture: PygameReferenceCanvas + PygameSceneRenderer + layered semantic scene nodes (clouds, distant hills, garden beds, tactile toolbox, particle fountains)
